I say "virtual server" when I talk about my computer project. I say "container" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use cloud service, virtual server, and container. At the end, I say: I can use cloud service clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“云服务器与容器”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。cloud service：云服务，通过互联网提供的计算或存储能力。示例：I learned how to use "cloud service" in a computer task.virtual server：虚拟服务器，在物理机器中模拟出的独立服务器。示例：I learned how to use "virtual server" in a computer task.container：容器，把应用和依赖封装在一起的运行环境。示例：I learned how to use "container" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“发布与版本”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。release：发布，把一个可用版本正式提供给用户。示例：Our team uses "release" to keep the project clear.release note：发布说明，介绍新版本的变化。示例：Our team uses "release note" to keep the project clear.version tag：版本标签，为某次提交添加版本标记。示例：Our team uses "version tag" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

At the end, I say: I can use semantic versioning clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“发布与版本”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。semantic versioning：语义化版本，用主版本、次版本和修订号表达变化。示例：Our team uses "semantic versioning" to keep the project clear.pre-release：预发布版本，在正式发布前供测试的版本。示例：Our team uses "pre-release" to keep the project clear.publish a release：发布版本，在 GitHub 上创建正式发布页面。示例：Our team uses "publish a release" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
